title: 4 ways to automate Granola with your AI agent and Zapier
summary: Granola does a great job of capturing your meeting. What happens next is on you: copying the notes into a doc, pasting the recap into Slack, typing the follow-ups into Asana, logging the call in HubSpot. When the meeting ends and the chat window closes, so does the help. Now you can automate Granola from the AI tool you already use.
